Short-form video

Why Your Reels Aren’t Getting Views

Review the opening, framing, message, and next step before adding more effects.

Run More Ads · Updated 10 October 2026

Make the opening understandable

Show the subject quickly. A viewer should be able to tell what the video is about without reading a long caption. Start with a recognisable action, a product in use, or a clear statement.

Keep one idea in focus

A short video is easier to follow when it develops one message. Remove scenes that repeat the same point or distract from the offer. Use editing to guide attention, and keep captions readable.

Respect the viewing environment

Check vertical framing, caption placement, sound-off viewing, and the final call to action. Important information should stay clear of interface elements. Preview the creative on a phone before publishing it.

Review more than views

A video with modest reach may still create useful enquiries or purchases. Compare attention measures with the campaign goal and the destination experience. Use those observations to choose the next creative test.
